# Admission fixture

This disposable browser application repository is the only writable product scope. Run Full Delivery from accepted docs/specs/full-small/SPEC.md and PLAN.md through implementation, Project Verification, final acceptance, and readonly Code Review with retained report. Use the selected workflow contracts under .agents/skills as authoritative for this fixture. Other installed copies cannot substitute for these selected source bytes.

Delegate implementation to native scoped workers on the current branch. The parent owns docs/specs/full-small/PLAN.md, IMPLEMENTATION-NOTES.md and Task Gates. Workers are not alone and must preserve other edits. Use the same native model, reasoning, tools and available capacity selected by the caller for all workers and reviewers. Read relevant source only when the selected workflow calls for it. Read .agents/skills/writing-for-agents/SKILL.md for verifier or workflow document writes. Use established standalone Node conventions; this fixture has no Effect application runtime.

Provider task projection uses provider-task mode with per-run exact IDs and current native hierarchy/milestone/blocker readback in CONTEXT.json. Preserve source contract requirements for remote spec retention, branch/base, draft PR visibility and report retention. Preparation supplies verified remote spec retention and current Write Backlog result before launch; unresolved preparation fields prevent launch. Real browser UI gates apply. Infrastructure deployment gates are not applicable to this local browser fixture. All task, TDD, runtime, Verification, architecture where applicable, final acceptance, readonly review and report retention gates remain required. Record these applicability decisions rather than invent provider readbacks. Selected reusable skill copies remain uncommitted and unchanged; project-owned verifier references may be authored when selected workflow requires them. Remote mutations are limited to the exact fixture repository, run branch and draft PR authorized in CONTEXT.json. Preserve all other branches and repositories; merge, release and canonical-source publication are outside scope. Report unavailable native capabilities or blocked gates truthfully.
